chunks: From him, from Yaqoub ibn Yazeed, from Ziyad ibn Marwan al-Qandy, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The one who eats seven Ajwa dates at his sleep time, would kill the insects in his belly.

key_terms.عَجْوَةٍ: A specific, highly regarded variety of dates from Medina, known for its medicinal properties.
key_terms.عِنْدَ مَنَامِهِ: At the time of sleeping or before going to bed.

ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of eating Ajwa dates before sleeping according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) underscores the prophetic tradition of consuming Ajwa dates as a preventive measure against intestinal parasites, reflecting the holistic integration of physical health and spiritual discipline in Shia jurisprudence. The specific emphasis on 'seven' dates aligns with numerological significance in hadith literature, while the reference to 'Ajwa' (from Medina) highlights the premium status of this variety in Islamic medicinal practice.
